historical_references.reference: Rushaid ibn Jabir al-Asadi was a popular poet during the Abbasid Caliphate. He is considered to be one of the great masters of Arabic poetry, particularly in the genres of love poetry and panegyrics. His poems were widely admired and imitated.
historical_references.context: literary figure during the Abbasid Caliphate

historical_references.reference: Rushaid ibn Zaid was a Berber military leader who played a significant role in the Islamic conquest of Spain. He is known for his successful campaigns against the Visigoths and his rule over the region of Al-Andalus during the Umayyad Caliphate. His reign marked the beginning of Muslim rule in Spain.
historical_references.context: Berber military leader during the Islamic conquest of Spain
